california-puzzle-supabase.value: Supabase Integration Architecture completed. Key decisions: 1) Anonymous-first authentication, 2) Progressive enhancement (Supabase optional), 3) Offline-first with localStorage primary, 4) Last-write-wins conflict resolution, 5) Non-blocking background sync. Full architecture document: docs/architecture/SUPABASE_INTEGRATION_ARCHITECTURE.md. Ready for implementation phase.
